video_title: SLOWING DOWN Jalen Brunson ✍️ Has the Spurs' defense found the blueprint in the NBA Finals? | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: The electric atmosphere at MSG could impact the Knicks' performance
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be one of the most electric atmospheres you could ever create.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: We've seen the Knicks lose some huge games at home, playoff games over the years. I've been at a lot of them. You do know how the Garden is going to feel. It's going to be one of the most electric atmospheres you could ever create.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: Phil could say that because he had a guy wearing 23 in red. In your head, the greatest shots Jordan hit, more of them, the preponderance of them, he was wearing red or white.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks remain focused despite the pressure of the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I did not see a hint of anybody breaking from the message, which was, this ain't over.
quotes.quote: I don't know if somebody called a team meeting or if it's just something that has been reinforced throughout the course of the season, but yesterday, the Knicks were absolutely 100% focused. I did not see a hint of anybody breaking from the message, which was, this ain't over. We got a lot of work to do. I appreciate that New York is very excited, but I can't be bothered with it. I did not see one hint of a team that thinks that it's got the corner turned.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' bench production is critical during high-pressure playoff games
quotes.excerpt: It's easy when your starters are locked in, doesn't mean that your role players are locked in as well.
quotes.quote: This could be an interesting scenario where there's so much going on. You could see the starters locked in, but do you get the same bench production because of everything going on? Bench production has been a main thing for them. You talked about their depth, Landry Shamet, guys knocking down shots from the outside. It's easy when your starters are locked in, doesn't mean that your role players are locked in as well.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must deliver an A-plus game for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: They need an A-plus game from him. Doesn't mean they're going to win if he has an A-plus game.
quotes.quote: They need an A-plus game from him. Doesn't mean they're going to win if he has an A-plus game and everybody else is not up to the moment. That's what's great about watching the Spurs evolve at what pace, at what rate. Can Victor bring them along with him? We're at the crossroads. If they're going to do that this year, and I still think it's almost, I don't want to say unfair, the Spurs have been so great to watch.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' defensive strategy against Jalen Brunson is wearing him down
quotes.excerpt: This is about the cumulative effect of when Brunson is in the shoot or pass decision area.
quotes.quote: This is about the cumulative effect of when Brunson is in the shoot or pass decision area, which is in that paint. You want to give him a variety of different looks. You've seen them do double teams before. You're going to see a lot of more straight-up play and how they're going to guard here. He's in a 1v1 here against a guy who's an alien and he's going to have to get a shot off. He knows Victor Wembanyama is on his side and he can block his shot late.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' rotation of athletic guards is forcing Jalen Brunson to work
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs have a seemingly never-ending rotation of incredibly athletic guards who can go out and force him.
quotes.quote: The strategy the Spurs have employed against Brunson has worked. It reminds me of what they did against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, who was the two-time defending MVP. The Spurs have a seemingly never-ending rotation of incredibly athletic guards who can go out and force him to work so hard. Brunson is working so hard just to get the ball over the timeline in eight seconds that I'm not surprised at all that he looks worn down in these fourth quarters.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs are betting that making other Knicks beat them will work
quotes.excerpt: The strategy of making somebody else besides Brunson beat you is working.
quotes.quote: What the Spurs basically are going to wager on is that the strategy of making somebody else besides Brunson beat you is working. I think their strategy of making OG Anunoby, make Landry Shamet, make Mikal Bridges beat you, I think they're comfortable with that. And I do think that the pressure would be on those guys if Brunson is not able to have a big game tonight.
